description: This file defines classes and behaviors related to layout management in Kivy's RecycleView, including selection behavior and layout management strategies.

classes.name: LayoutChangeException
classes.description: Custom exception class for layout-related errors.

classes.name: LayoutSelectionBehavior
classes.description: Behavior class that adds selection capabilities to layouts within a RecycleView, allowing selection via keyboard or touch, and managing view selection states.

classes.name: RecycleLayoutManagerBehavior
classes.description: Base class responsible for positioning, managing, and updating views within a RecycleView, including attaching/detaching to a RecycleView, computing sizes and layout, and handling view visibility.

methods.name: compute_sizes_from_data
methods.description: Method to compute sizes based on data; implementation is specific to subclasses.

methods.name: compute_layout
methods.description: Method to compute layout; implementation is specific to subclasses.

methods.name: compute_visible_views
methods.description: Determines which views are visible within the current viewport.

methods.name: set_visible_views
methods.description: Sets which views are visible based on indices and viewport.

methods.name: get_view_index_at
methods.description: Returns the index of the view at a given position within the layout.

methods.name: goto_view
methods.description: Scrolls or moves views to make the specified index visible; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: on_viewclass
methods.description: Handles updates when the viewclass property changes, resolving string to class if necessary.
